# CRA XML schemas

Downloaded on 4 November 2026.

The file `xmlschm1-26-3.zip` is CRA's schema package, version 1-26-3. CRA's page says it was last updated on 23 December 2025. CanDo did not write these schemas.

- File: https://www.canada.ca/content/dam/cra-arc/serv-info/eservices/xmlschm1-26-3.zip
- Page that lists it: https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/e-services/filing-information-returns-electronically-t4-t5-other-types-returns-overview/filing-information-returns-electronically-t4-t5-other-types-returns-what-you-should-know-before.html

T4 submissions are checked against `T619_T4.xsd` inside the zip. T4A submissions are checked against `T619_T4A.xsd`.
